_doc: Every non-view external function and who may call it (40_verification.md 4.2). Adding a function without updating this file fails verify:design (D20). Callers: forwarder, self, receiver, vault, timelock, officers(n), deployer-once, submitter, key-holder, anyone, faucet, test-only. OfficerDesk: officer actions for one Receiver (docs/47 3.2); no owner, no config; signatures verified there, state checks in the Receiver.

QuorumReceiver.onReport(bytes,bytes): forwarder (+ whitelisted workflow owner/name in PROD, tx.origin == simOperator in SIM)
QuorumReceiver.releaseExpired(bytes32): anyone (only gives back expired unused approvals)
QuorumReceiver.initialize(tuple): deployer-once (vaults, cold, ThreatRegistry, DecoyCommit, PatrolState, OfficerDesk; locked after first call; D20)
QuorumReceiver.deskExtendFreeze(address,uint64): desk only (OfficerDesk, set once at initialize; officers(2) there), only extends
QuorumReceiver.deskManualApprove(bytes32): desk only, after officers(2) + MANUAL_DELAY on the desk
QuorumReceiver.deskLowerAlert(uint8): desk only, after officers(2) + MANUAL_DELAY on the desk; only lowers
QuorumReceiver.deskHold(bytes32,uint64): desk only (officers(1) there); one unused APPROVE, at most holdMax, expires, cooldown holdMax
QuorumReceiver.deskCancelVerdict(bytes32): desk only (officers(2) there); one unused APPROVE
QuorumReceiver.userCancelVerdict(bytes32,uint64,bytes): anyone relaying a CancelWithdrawal signature from the user's registered key; one unused APPROVE of that user (docs/47 3.3)

QuorumVault.execute(tuple): anyone, but needs a consumed verdict from the receiver
QuorumVault.refillQuota(address,uint64,uint256): receiver (r_max, epoch, cap; not at CONFIRMED or frozen)
QuorumVault.topUp(address,uint256): receiver (warm to immutable sibling hot only)
QuorumVault.setProtectedLane(address,uint256,uint256: timelock (docs/47 R7 protected lane; cap 0 = off)

RequestBoard.submit(tuple,tuple,bytes): submitter (registered for the org; rate limited)

KeyRegistry.register(bytes32,address,uint64,bytes): key-holder signature (queued if the account has deposits)
KeyRegistry.requestKeyChange(bytes32,address,uint64,: new key signature (recovery): queued RECOVERY_DELAY, cancellable by the current key, the second factor or officers(1)
KeyRegistry.cancelKeyChange(bytes32,uint64,bytes): current key or second factor signature
KeyRegistry.rotateKey(bytes32,address,uint64,bytes,b: current key and new key co-sign (immediate)
KeyRegistry.approveRecovery(bytes32,uint64,bytes): second factor signature: shortens a queued recovery to KEY_CHANGE_DELAY
KeyRegistry.registerSecondFactor(bytes32,address,uin: current key and factor co-sign; queued KEY_CHANGE_DELAY when the account has deposits

ThreatRegistry.add(address,uint64,bytes32,bytes32,uint6: receiver (registered reporter); no remove or block function exists

DecoyCommit.revealThreshold(bytes32,uint64,address,u: receiver of that org (THRESHOLD_REVEAL, must match commitment)

PatrolState.registerPlannedOp(address,address,uint64: officers(2), window <= 24h, discounts CUSUM input only

OfficerDesk.holdVerdict(bytes32,uint64,uint256,uint6: officers(1), one unused APPROVE, at most holdMax, expires, cooldown holdMax (docs/47)
